d: An all-star panel with Kim Gravel, Shirley Strawberry, Nicole Polizzi, and Jenni Farley! Steve tests high-end luxury products.

st: I'm 17, Are You My Daddy?
d: Keyonna was just 15 years young when she had her daughter Keyarra. Motherhood was daunting for Keyonna, but she did her best to raise her daughter.

st: Too Many People In This Relationship
d: Ta'Laiya and De'Asia have been friends since the 7th grade and stopped speaking because of a damaged wig. De'Asia wants to rekindle their friendship but doesn't believe she's responsible for the damage to the wig.

d: Shamika's video went viral after she caught her husband, Ifeanyi, at a hotel with another woman on their anniversary! The couple is here to see what, if anything, Karamo can do to salvage their marriage!

st: Unlock The Phone II
d: Jeremiah and Nancy have been together for four years and have two children. They look like the picture-perfect family, but this couple is at war as accusations of cheating continue to surface. Jeremiah even questions whether their children are really his.

st: Our Love Went Viral
d: Trevor and his wife DeLessa are no strangers to the reality television world. But Trevor believes DeLessa has taken things too far and doesn't prioritize their family and relationship. DeLessa says being on social media is how she makes money.

st: We Had a Threesome... Is Your Man My Baby's Dad?
d: Sean and his girlfriend Lanika deny that he is the father of Rebecca's baby. Then, Kyrstal and Precious want to prove that their brother London did not father Paula's baby. Teen mom Alicia cheated on Tony, but doesn't know if he's the baby's father!

st: Is My Sister's Fiancé or My Ex My Baby's Father?
d: Today on MAURY, Brian, his mom, and his sister all deny Sarah's baby. Then, Robert always wanted a dad, but James always denied him. Plus its grandmother verses grandmother in DNA war that spans generations!

st: I Saw You Cheat... My Son Is Not Your Baby's Father!
d: Nick denies Chantelle's baby, but she wants to prove he's the father and make him pay up. Mario's mother Evette says she went "undercover" to prove that Sierra cheated on her son and that he is not her baby's father! What will the DNA results reveal?

t: The Maury Show: I Cheated... Our Kids May Not Be Yours!
st: I Cheated... Our Kids May Not Be Yours!
d: Two steaming grandmothers want to sort out their children's paternity mystery. Then, Ben is sure that Angela's child is his. Teen mom Melissa wants Izzy to admit he's the dad and support her!

t: The Maury Show: They're Back: Feuding Family Updates!
st: They're Back: Feuding Family Updates!
d: Some of our wildest guests reutrn to give us some updates. Did the DNA results force these denying dads to step up? Did the lie detector results force these cheaters to become faithful?

t: The Maury Show: I Cheated With Your Family and 97 Women
st: I Cheated With Your Family and 97 Women
d: These women are sure their lovers are cheating.  Will these men be able to talk their way out of being busted on hidden camera?

t: The Maury Show: 5 Babies 5 DNA Tests. Is He The Father?
st: 5 Babies 5 DNA Tests. Is He The Father?
d: Today on Maury, we've got steaming mad mommas and daddies in denial. But could some of these men be right? What if they really aren't the father? Only Maury has the answers!

t: The Maury Show: We'll Prove You're My Baby's Dad!
st: We'll Prove You're My Baby's Dad!
d: Kreisha and Jonathan's mom wants to prove to him that he fathered her baby. Plus, Brooke and Wade's relationship began as a teenage romance, but ends with a paternity test!

st: Dump Your Cheating Lover!
d: Niki is here to beg her sister, Margerie, to leave her cheating husband, Chris. But Margerie claims to still love him even though he's still seeing Rhonda. However, Rhonda tells Chris she's fed up with his lying and she won't be fooled!

st: I Share My Lover!
d: Beth and Eric have been dating for a year. But Eric began sleeping with Beth's sister with Beth's permission! Beth now says she only gave it because she was scared of losing Eric. Both women claim to love Eric and want him for their own.
